title: Integer arithmetic
description:
Write in `solution.c`:

```c
int minutes_part(int seconds);       /* 125 -> 2 */
int seconds_part(int seconds);       /* 125 -> 5 */
double average3(int a, int b, int c);/* an exact average: average3(1, 2, 2) is 1.666... */
int last_digit(int n);               /* n >= 0: 4072 -> 2 */
int round_to(int n, int step);       /* n >= 0, step > 0: the nearest multiple of step, halves round up: round_to(17, 5) is 15, round_to(18, 5) is 20 */
```

Watch the integer division in `average3`: convert to `double` before dividing.
hints: `average3(2000000000, 2000000000, 2000000000)`: adding three ints that big overflows `int`. Convert the first one to `double` before adding: `((double)a + b + c)`.
